timeline.title: Research Assistant
timeline.description:
Lead multidisciplinary research initiatives at the intersection of AI in Healthcare, Medical AI, Agentic AI, AI Security, and Human–Computer Interaction (HCI). Coordinate three funded research projects involving 10+ researchers across five research teams, providing research direction, technical oversight, project coordination, and researcher mentorship. Work closely with professors, physicians, neurosurgeons, oncology specialists, mathematicians, AI researchers, and other domain experts to translate clinical and scientific requirements into rigorous AI research and practical healthcare applications.

Core Research Areas:
• AI in Healthcare & Medical Imaging: Developing and evaluating deep learning and computer vision approaches for healthcare research, with applications in breast cancer, cervical cancer, lung cancer, and brain stroke.
• Medical Agentic AI & Intelligent Systems: Researching agentic workflows, intelligent decision-support systems, AI-assisted healthcare applications, and HCI approaches for medical contexts.
• AI Security & Responsible AI: Investigating security, reliability, robustness, and emerging risks associated with AI models and agentic systems in healthcare environments.

Leadership & Research Contributions:
• Scientific Publication: Contributed to 5 Q1 journal manuscripts—3 submitted and 2 in progress.
• Researcher Development: Mentor and train junior researchers in medical image analysis, machine learning, AI model development, experimental methodology, and research practices.
• Technical Research Leadership: Contribute hands-on to the design, development, experimentation, evaluation, and documentation of AI models and healthcare-focused intelligent applications.
• End-to-End Research Coordination: Support research activities across the full lifecycle, including problem formulation, dataset preparation, ethical considerations, model development, experimentation, evaluation, documentation, and publication.

Develop deep learning & computer vision models for breast, cervical, lung cancer, and brain stroke
Investigate agentic workflows, intelligent decision-support systems, and healthcare AI security
Mentor and train junior researchers in medical image analysis, machine learning, and research practices
